To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
intra-industry entrepreneurial experience and failure experience are important for the development of novel business models and that the effect of intra-industry experience is non-linear.

(a) intra industry entrepreneurial experience is positively associated with the novelty centered business model and new venture growth, (b) failure entrepreneurial experience is positively related to the novelty centered business mode and new venture growth.

intra industry entrepreneurial experiences have an inverted U shaped relationship with novelty centered business model and that the relationship is strengthened by risk perception and weakened by environmental uncertainty.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how entrepreneurs learn from entrepreneurial experience for business design and how business design affects venture growth.
entrepreneurial learning from prior entrepreneurial experience, novelty centered business model, and new venture growth.
how entrepreneurs learn from their prior entrepreneurial experience to design novel business models and how novel business model design affects new venture growth.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
entrepreneurs can learn from their prior entrepreneurial experience to design a more novel business model.

intra industry entrepreneurial experiences have an inverted U shaped relationship with novelty centered business model innovation, while failure entrepreneurial experience is positively related to novelty centered business model.
intra industry entrepreneurial experiences are more likely to be used as an input for business model design when environmental uncertainty is high and risk perception is low.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
entrepreneurs learn from prior failure and intra industry entrepreneurial experience, but not from success, to develop novelty centered business model.
entrepreneurs’ intra industry entrepreneurial experience helps them learn how to design business model that is less novel.
entrepreneurs’ prior experience is an important source of knowledge for business model design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
entrepreneurial learning and novel business model design can be complementary in some cases.
entrepreneurial experience has a complex effect on business model design.
entrepreneurs should learn from failure entrepreneurial experience and intra industry entrepreneurial experience for novelty centered business model innovation and new venture growth.
